summary: The stored rating rests on an acute vinegar-with-a-meal meta-analysis and an abstract-less letter, neither about capsules or gummies. Pooled evidence is liquid at mL doses, with high heterogeneity, and the 2025 weight meta-analysis (41010525) lists a trial since retracted (38966098). The only solid-form trial found is one 12-week capsule RCT at 1500 mg/day in women with PCOS, metabolic syndrome and metformin (42215584), positive on insulin resistance. A short crossover at 30 mL/day was null on energy expenditure (34055150). No gummy trial was found.
